title: Enter on a Tab-focused section strip button does the section's Enter action instead
notes: section-strip.ts: the window's capture-phase lookup in renderer.ts claims a bare Enter for the current section even when focus is on a strip button. Tab to Board on the strip, press Enter, and the selected worktree opens instead of the board. In the command section, the typed command runs in every marked project. Fix: make the strip buttons pointer-only (tabIndex -1 plus a mousedown preventDefault, like createAddPaneButton in chrome-bars.ts); Alt+H and Alt+L already walk the strip. Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/170 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/169#discussion_r4437837755

comments.body: Shipped in #202: section strip names take no keyboard focus (tabIndex -1, one mousedown preventDefault on the strip). pressesWalkedToButton from #169 already let Enter press a Tab-focused strip button; this removes the strip from that question.
